title: WWII Soldier POV: Iwo Jima — Black Sand Landing
hook: The ramp drops onto black volcanic sand — and every step sinks beneath you.
shortDescription: Experience the opening days of Iwo Jima from the first-person perspective of a fictional U.S. Marine. Cinematic historical reenactment, not archival footage.
longDescription: Step into an immersive first-person historical reenactment of the Battle of Iwo Jima beginning February 19, 1945. This episode follows a fictional composite U.S. Marine from the landing craft onto the island's black volcanic beaches, through the difficult inland push and airfield terrain, to a later distant view of Mount Suribachi after the flag raising. The story ends by making clear that the battle continued for weeks. AI-generated cinematic reenactment, not real wartime footage.
disclosure: AI-generated cinematic historical reenactment. Not archival footage.
audience: Global WWII, military history and cinematic POV audiences
